description: This file defines the `BitState` class, which manages the state of bit indices, likely in the context of configuration or data encoding. It provides methods to increment, reset, and retrieve the current bit index, with logic to handle bit overflow conditions.

classes.name: BitState
classes.description: Class for managing a stateful index of bits, including incrementing with overflow checks, reset, and retrieval.

methods.name: incrementBitIndex
methods.description: Increments the bit index if the provided ConfigField is a bit; resets to 0 otherwise; throws an exception if the bit count exceeds 31.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the bit index to zero.
